subject: general
question: In June 2024, the Indian Army opened the Khalubar War Memorial to tourists, which is located in _____, India.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Ladakh**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Khalubar War Memorial is located in Ladakh, India. **
 
• The** Indian Army opened the memorial to tourists in June 2024. **
 
• The Khalubar War Memorial **is a tribute to the soldiers who fought in the 1999** Kargil War between India and Pakistan.
 
• The memorial **was opened as part of the "Forever in Operations" Division's pre-Kargil Vijay Diwas celebrations.**
 
• **The Kargil War Memorial is also known as the Dras War Memorial. It is located in the town of Dras, near Kargil **city in the Kargil district of Ladakh.
 
• The Kargil War Memorial is a poignant tribute to the soldiers who lost their lives in the war.
 
• It is set against the backdrop of Tololing Peak and the Dras Valley.​

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The** Indian Army is the land-based branch and largest component of the Indian Armed Forces**.
 
• The President of India is the Supreme Commander of the Indian Army,
 
 
• and its professional head is the Chief of Army Staff (COAS).
 
• The** Indian Army was established on 1 April 1895 alongside the long established presidency armies of the East India Company**, which too were absorbed into it in 1903.
